<!-- A proposal is not an accepted specification change. -->

## Summary

<!-- Describe the proposed decision in a few sentences. -->

## Problem And Motivation

<!-- What current limitation or ambiguity does this address? Link to the owning
documentation, an existing RFC, or a small public example. -->

## Proposed Change

<!-- Name the affected concept, manifest kind, field, validation rule, or tool
contract. Include a short before-and-after example when an authored shape
would change. State what remains out of scope. -->

## Alternatives Considered

<!-- What simpler or existing approach could solve the problem? Why is it
insufficient? -->

## Compatibility, Versioning, And Migration

<!-- Which existing inputs or consumers would change meaning or stop working?
Identify the affected version domain, any deprecated form, and a migration
path. If there is no impact, explain why. -->

## Safety And Authority

<!-- Describe effects on identity, permissions, approval, autonomy, context,
memory, credentials, network access, audit, and human override where relevant.
State whether provider or runtime neutrality changes. Use "not applicable"
for unaffected areas. -->

## Evidence And Validation Plan

<!-- What example, fixture, schema check, semantic check, or review would show
that the proposal works? Note what the evidence cannot prove. -->

## RFC Route

<!-- Should this use the RFC process? Yes / No / Unsure. Give a short reason
based on the change types in CONTRIBUTING.md and link an existing RFC if one
covers the proposal. Maintainers will confirm the route. -->

## Open Questions

<!-- List decisions that still need review. "None" is fine. -->
